name: Trope
long_description:
Trope is the AI-native ERP system integrator.

We accelerate months of hourly implementation work with agent-driven, fixed-fee delivery. Instead of leaving customers with a static system, we deploy AI agents that continue running and improving core business operations after go-live.

Trope combines AI trained on ERP systems with principal consultants who have delivered 200+ implementations over 20 years. Together, they turn consulting services into software, shifting systems integration from one-time implementations to continuous AI-driven operations.
